title: Agri Drone Sprayer Revolutionizing Farming
reason: Highlights the key features and benefits of the Agri Drone Sprayer in modern agriculture.

tasks.task: Demonstrate the capabilities and advantages of the Agri Drone Sprayer in precision spraying.

subtasks.text: Observe the Agri Drone Sprayer described as a "tech marvel" and a "game changer" in the field of agriculture.
Note that the drone is capable of spray-painting crops with pesticides and fertilizers.
Highlight how the drone ensures every inch of the field is covered with precision.
Watch the drone achieve pinpoint accuracy, reducing waste and increasing efficiency.
Observe that the drone works effectively on any terrain and large fields.

tasks.task: Show how the Agri Drone Sprayer sets new standards in modern farming.

subtasks.text: Note the mention of various crop types including "patty fields to corn mazes."
Observe the emphasis on embracing the use of technology in agriculture.
Highlight the statement that the Agri Drone Sprayer represents a change for the better.
